LanguageData.MS_Printer_IgnoreNonPrinterOrdersDesc: When enabled, this printer ignores all orders whose worker setting is not "Printers only".
LanguageData.MS_Printer_SettingsDesc: Adjust this printer's work speed, output efficiency and quality settings.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_Hint: Save settings for this printer or copy them to other printers on this map. Production progress is stored in the control core. The worker that finishes a batch determines its output and quality.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_SpeedTip: 100% matches a human colonist's normal work speed.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_EfficiencyTip: Multiplier for the number of items produced.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_SkillTip: Determines which recipes can be crafted and generates base quality using the vanilla formula.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_OffsetTip: Quality levels added to or removed from vanilla base quality.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_InspirationTip: Chance for a finished product to gain one quality level. Independent of malfunction; simultaneous triggers cancel out.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_FailureTip: Chance for a finished product to lose one quality level. Independent of inspiration; simultaneous triggers cancel out.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_CopyToOthersTip: Save these settings and colonist binding to this printer and copy them to all other player-owned cosmic printers on this map. Manual parameters are only copied when parameter changes are enabled.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_CopiedToOthers: Settings saved and copied to {0} other printers.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_EditingLocked: Manual parameters are locked in the mod options. Colonist binding is still available.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_FollowBoundPawn: Uses bound colonist's attributes and skills
LanguageData.MS_Printer_BindingTip: Produce using a colonist's attributes and skills.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_PreviewHint: Preview only; based on recipe and skill.
LanguageData.MS_Printer_Idle: Waiting for an available core order
LanguageData.MS_Printer_PauseBoundAway: Bound colonist is not on this map
LanguageData.MS_Printer_PauseBoundNotColonist: Bound pawn is no longer a player colonist
LanguageData.MS_Printer_PauseBoundNoSkills: Bound colonist has no usable skills
LanguageData.MS_Printer_PauseUnavailable: Printer is not an active player building
LanguageData.MS_Printer_PauseDisconnected: Not connected to a working storage network
